[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]We will need to traverse Sword Valley[XENO:n ]
if we wish to reach Galahad Fortress.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]If Colony 6 were in better shape, we could[XENO:n ]
have taken a pod from there.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
How are we getting there?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]We will take the path down from the Giant God's right arm.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Sword Valley is where the arm[XENO:n ]
meets the Machine God' sword.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]So that's our route.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT13 ]As I said earlier, it is a snow-covered mountain[XENO:n ]
range, and you should expect a tough climb.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Are we all ready?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]Ready as we'll ever be![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

First, we will head through Makna Forest.[XENO:n ]
This short-range pod will be our transport.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
